glosses: unpleasant, disagreeable, distasteful, off-putting, displeasing, unpleasing, bad, rude, unsavory, uncomfortable, unlikable, objectionable, painful, uncongenial, crappy, gnarly (US slang)

examples.text: Tom es una de las personas más desagradables que conozco.
examples.en: Tom is one of the most disagreeable people I know.

examples.text: La gente ha perdido la capacidad de no estar de acuerdo sin dejar de ser desagradables.
examples.en: People have lost the ability to disagree without being disagreeable.
